title: pvAggregateDataset
body:
## pvAggregateDataset

Parallel data-movement filter: gathers the pieces of a distributed dataset onto NumberOfTargetProcesses MPI processes (ParaView default 1), leaving the other processes empty; VTK documents it for polydata and unstructured grids. Use it in MPI runs to reduce the number of pieces before writing or rendering a modest result. In a serial run there is only one process and the data pass through. Input must be a single, non-composite dataset.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Gathering a large dataset onto few processes can exhaust their memory.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AggregateDataset`. Identity: `filters/AggregateDataSet`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NumberOfTargetProcesses` | This property specifies the number of target processes to aggregate the dataset onto. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAggregateDataset",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
